DEFAULTS.platform.DOC: Name of the board or model being tested
DEFAULTS.parent.DOC: Name of the platform whose overrides to inherit
DEFAULTS.models.DOC: Model-specific attribute overrides for this platform. This field should not be used in a parent config.
DEFAULTS.mode_switcher_type.DOC: Version of mode-switcher used for mode-aware reboot
DEFAULTS.is_detachable.DOC: Whether the device is a detachable
DEFAULTS.chrome_ec.DOC: Whether the platform has an EC
DEFAULTS.ec_ro_vbus_bug.DOC: Whether The EC RO firmware has a bug that causes Vbus is not supplied in SRC.ACCESORY state
DEFAULTS.chrome_usbpd.DOC: Whether the platform supports USB power delivery
DEFAULTS.has_lid.DOC: Whether the platform has a physical lid
DEFAULTS.has_keyboard.DOC: Whether the platform has a physical keyboard
DEFAULTS.has_powerbutton.DOC: Whether the platform has a physical power button
DEFAULTS.power_button_dev_switch.DOC: Whether the power button switches to dev mode
DEFAULTS.rec_button_dev_switch.DOC: Whether the recovery button switches to dev mode
DEFAULTS.ec_capability.DOC: Map of capabilities of the Chrome EC
DEFAULTS.cr50_capability.DOC: List of capabilities of the CR50
DEFAULTS.custom_usb_enable_pins.DOC: List of USB-A enable GPIO pin names with optional io expander flags. From usb_port_enable[] in board.c.
DEFAULTS.usb_a_port_count.DOC: The number of USB-A ports on the device to be tested. -1 means unknown, do not use -1 for new boards.
DEFAULTS.spi_voltage.DOC: The voltage level to set on the servo's spi2_vref
DEFAULTS.usbc_input_voltage_limit.DOC: The max input voltage for USB Type-C port
DEFAULTS.charger_profile_override.DOC: Whether the platform has a custom charger profile, which takes over the control of voltage/current limit
DEFAULTS.has_eventlog.DOC: Whether the platform has eventlog support including proper timestamps. (Only for old boards! Never disable this 'temporarily, until we get around to implementing it'!)
DEFAULTS.firmware_screen.DOC: Delay between power-on and firmware screen
DEFAULTS.serial_firmware_boot_delay.DOC: Extra time to add to `firmware_screen` delay if using serial port is enabled in AP firmware.
DEFAULTS.delay_powerinfo_stable.DOC: Delay between AP power-on and when powerinfo is stable. Some CPUs have an internal reset that transitions through different power states.
DEFAULTS.delay_reboot_to_ping.DOC: Delay between reboot and first ping response from the DUT. When this times out, it indicates we're stuck at a firmware screen. Hence, bypass action has to be taken if we want to proceed.
DEFAULTS.keypress_delay.DOC: Delay between keypresses in firmware screen
DEFAULTS.dev_screen_timeout.DOC: The developer screen timeout fits our spec
DEFAULTS.usb_plug.DOC: Delay between power-on and plug USB
DEFAULTS.usb_unplug.DOC: Delay between USB power-off and detected by the system
DEFAULTS.shutdown.DOC: Delay for waiting for client to shutdown
DEFAULTS.ec_boot_to_console.DOC: Delay between EC boot and ChromeEC console functional
DEFAULTS.ec_boot_to_pwr_button.DOC: Delay between EC boot and pressing power button
DEFAULTS.ec_boot_to_wp_en.DOC: Delay for AP initiating an EC reboot in order to enable EC WP
DEFAULTS.minios_screen.DOC: Delay between selecting booting minios and minios screen
DEFAULTS.hibernate.DOC: True if the device supports hibernation
DEFAULTS.ec_has_powerbtn_cmd.DOC: EC, if present, supports 'powerbtn' console command
DEFAULTS.ec_reboot_to_g3_delay.DOC: Delay for waiting EC turning off the AP
DEFAULTS.software_sync.DOC: Delay of EC software sync hash calculating time
DEFAULTS.software_sync_update.DOC: Delay of EC software sync updating EC
DEFAULTS.hold_pwr_button_poweroff.DOC: Duration of holding power button to power off DUT normally
DEFAULTS.hold_pwr_button_nopowerd_shutdown.DOC: Duration of holding down power button to shut down without powerd
DEFAULTS.hold_pwr_button_poweron.DOC: Duration of holding power button to power on DUT normally (also known as SHORT_DELAY in hdctools)
DEFAULTS.powerup_ready.DOC: Delay after /sbin/shutdown before pressing power button
DEFAULTS.servo_prog_state_delay.DOC: Time in seconds to wait after changingt servo state for programming
DEFAULTS.usb_image_boot_timeout.DOC: Timeout of confirming DUT doesn't boot on USB image in Recovery screen
DEFAULTS.smm_store.DOC: Check SMMSTORE exists in FMap for x86 boards
DEFAULTS.lid_wake_from_power_off.DOC: True if the lid can wake the system from a powered off state
DEFAULTS.ac_on_can_wake_ap_from_ulp.DOC: True if the AC on event can wake the AP from ULP state
DEFAULTS.ap_access_ec_flash.DOC: True if AP can access the EC flash while Chrome OS is running
DEFAULTS.rec_force_mrc.DOC: True if the device supports power_state:rec_force_mrc, which forced memroy retraining in recovery mode
DEFAULTS.gsc_can_wake_ec_with_reset.DOC: True if the GSC can wake the EC with its reset GPIO
DEFAULTS.ap_up_after_cr50_reboot.DOC: True if AP is normally expected to be powered on after the Cr50 reboots (when AC power is connected)
DEFAULTS.gsc_update_wait_for_reboot.DOC: Number of seconds to wait for a gsc reboot after update
DEFAULTS.ec_forwards_short_pp_press.DOC: True if the EC will send short power button presses, such as those expected during CCD open, to the AP
DEFAULTS.serial_number_length.DOC: Length of serial number that can be set in firmware; if serial number cannot be set then 0
DEFAULTS.has_diagnostics_image.DOC: True if altfw/diag is build into RW_LEGACY
DEFAULTS.clear_dev_on_rec.DOC: True if dev mode get cleared upon entering rec mode
DEFAULTS.rma_entered_automatically.DOC: True if the will go into serial number screen automatically
DEFAULTS.dut_can_source_power_in_suspend.DOC: True if DUT will keep providing power to devices connected via USB-C when going to suspend
DEFAULTS.usb_hid_wake_enabled.DOC: True if wake from USB HID is supported
DEFAULTS.max_charging_power.DOC: Max charging power for DUT in watts
DEFAULTS.usbc_voltage_on_shutdown_and_full_batt.D: Input voltage limit applied by DUT when it is in G3/S5 and battery is full. 20 volts means there is no limit
